title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR AN ALLOWANCE IN ESTIMATING AND ASSESSING DUTIABLE GOODS IN CASE OF LOSS OR DESTRUCTION OF THE SAME.

title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan ketentuan tunjangan dalam memperkirakan dan menilai barang kena cukai apabila terjadi kehilangan atau kehancuran
title.ms: Akta menetapkan kaedah elaun bagi menganggar dan menilai barangan duti dalam kes hilang atau musnah

text.en:
If upon opening any package of dutiable goods, a deficiency of any article shall, on examination
by the inspector, be found, or if any article is found to be totally destroyed, the same shall be certified to the
Collector, who, if he shall be satisfied that such deficiency has occurred through no fault of the owner,
importer, or other person interested in such goods, shall make allowance for the same in estimating and
assessing duties.1aшphi1

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October, 3, 1900.
